title: One clean glossary of roles (coordinator, agent, session, lane, arbiter, triage) that reads and acts the same on local and cloud
why: The owner's first retrospective concern: the role words differ or clash between cloud and local sessions, and his environment should not change how things are set up or act.
note: Owner 14:17 CST Nov 10, in the retrospective session (relayed 14:18 CST), his words: "my first / number one concern is the roles of coordinator/agents/sessions/lanes/arbiter/triage/etc and how the differ / align on cloud sessions vs local sessions I want a clean glossary of terminology that feels intuitive, doesn't conflict, and results in the same setup/concepts if i'm on local or on cloud (my environment shouldn't cause things to be/act differently)". Extends decision lanes-start-as-agents (a lane is a session, local and cloud alike; owner Nov 4). Topic 1 closed by the owner 14:36 CST Nov 10 ("agree on your proposed close on topic 1 of the glossary", "yes it can be closed"; relayed by the retrospective session 14:38 CST): remove every local/cloud split a rule chose, so both places act the same; a split the platform forces lives only inside the tool, never in a role's definition. Splits to remove: (1) two different tests for 'is this the cloud'; (2) guards that judge only one of start_session and create_session; (3) the merge role file that exists only on the cloud; (4) the load brake, which runs only on the owner's computer; (5) an owner-started lane cannot merge on the cloud (docs/todo.md). Deferred by the owner 14:37 CST ("can be targeted after/later"): the details of forced splits, mainly a mixed local and cloud team while the mailbox bridge (MAILBOX_REPO) is off. Role words land first in glossary rulings G1-G10 (branch glossary-roles-g1-g3). Split into lanes 14:55 CST: both-session-starts-judged (now), brake-same-everywhere and merge-path-same-everywhere (after #2566). Mailbox address (mail.py:189) deferred by the owner. Owner 13:54 CST Nov 11 (relayed by the retrospective; plan 1b33c1e): "a": 3.0's records half (glossary, session-tiers, the CLAUDE.md role lines; G1-G3, G6, G7, G9, G10, G12, G13, G15) starts now as one lane before the fresh start; its code half (G11) waits for the guard test file split.
